description: This file implements the AAudioClientTracker class and its nested NotificationClient class, managing audio client registration, stream tracking, and cleanup in the Android AAudio system.

classes.name: AAudioClientTracker
classes.description: Singleton class that tracks audio clients and their streams, manages registration, deregistration, and cleanup.

classes.name: AAudioClientTracker::NotificationClient
classes.description: Represents a client with associated streams, handles stream registration, deregistration, and cleanup upon binder death.

methods.name: dump
methods.description: Returns a string dump of the current state of the tracker and its clients.

methods.name: registerClient
methods.description: Registers a new client with a process ID and client interface.

methods.name: unregisterClient
methods.description: Removes a client based on process ID.

methods.name: getStreamCount
methods.description: Returns the number of streams associated with a client process ID.

methods.name: registerClientStream
methods.description: Registers a stream for a specific client process ID.

methods.name: unregisterClientStream
methods.description: Unregisters a stream for a specific client process ID.

methods.name: setExclusiveEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables exclusive mode for a client.

methods.name: isExclusiveEnabled
methods.description: Checks if exclusive mode is enabled for a client.

methods.name: getNotificationClient_l
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a NotificationClient for a given process ID.
